overall: Phase 2 IN PROGRESS — selectable System One backend: JEV (cloud) or Laya-Android (on-device). Plan: docs/ON_DEVICE_SYSTEM1_PLAN.md
goal: Port brainstormity/System-One-Computer-Use to a native Android app: a floating mic overlay, OpenAI Realtime ('GPT live') voice front-end, and an on-device JEV screenshot→action loop driven through an AccessibilityService. Deliverable: a runnable debug APK tested on the Android emulator.

tasks.title: Research: current OpenAI Realtime API protocol (model id, WS events, tool calling, audio formats)
tasks.summary: docs/realtime-api-notes.md written. Key finding: OpenAI now has an official 'GPT-Live' product (gpt-live-1, $0.05/min) separate from the Realtime API (gpt-realtime-2.1). Sign-in-with-ChatGPT officially does not cover audio.

All checks passed on emulator-5554. install.sh now disables/re-enables the service around reinstalls.

tasks.title: JEV agent loop port (agent/): JevClient, TaskParser, TaskRunner with confidence gating, zoom refine, screen-settle wait
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Faithful port of run_task(): golden tests vs upstream Python (21 JVM tests pass), request bodies byte-identical, live JEV call OK (ask ~0.4 s, refine ~0.3 s). Run reports saved to files/runs/. Not yet exercised end-to-end on a device (T5).

tasks.title: Overlay bubble + status UI, foreground service, MainActivity setup/permissions/settings (overlay/, ui/)
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Draggable mic bubble + status pill, slim top strip with stop button while a task runs (reported via core/OverlayInfo.regions), setup checklist Activity with settings and text-task test box. Verified on emulator-5556. Caveat: the Settings app hides non-system overlays, so the strip is invisible there.

tasks.title: Voice auth: Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex PKCE OAuth), token refresh, Codex auth.json import for testing (voice/auth/)
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Codex PKCE OAuth (params verified against openai/codex source), loopback login on 127.0.0.1:1455, Keystore-encrypted token store, Codex auth.json import. AUTH_PROBE against chatgpt.com call endpoint: HTTP 400 'Offer did not have an audio media section' = auth and plan accepted (plan prolite). Refresh deliberately not exercised with the Mac's token (OpenAI rotates refresh tokens; would force a Mac re-login).

tasks.title: GPT-Live core: Live event protocol, Codex WebRTC call + control WebSocket, mic/speaker, delegation → TaskController (voice/live/, VoiceController)
tasks.summary: Merged to main. WebRTC call to chatgpt.com Codex GPT-Live (HTTP 201), control WS (101), delegation.created → TaskController → result appended → GPT speaks it. Verified with real spoken audio injected through a debug mic on emulator-5558. Adds stream-webrtc-android (APK ~54 MB).

tasks.title: API-key fallback: official GPT-Live API (gpt-live-1) over WebSocket, selectable in settings
tasks.summary: Merged to main. OpenAiLiveWsTransport (wss://api.openai.com/v1/live/sessions, gpt-live-1, PCM 24 kHz) + PcmAudio; chooser in VoiceBackends (auto/chatgpt/openai_key). 12 new JVM tests; live negative test: bad key → clean 401 error; Codex route regression OK. Untested with a real key (none provided).

tasks.title: Integration + end-to-end emulator test: voice (text-injected) → task → JEV loop → actions; final APK
tasks.summary: Merged to main. App class wiring, mic FGS type, sign-in + backend UI, overlay masked out of screenshots, 8 integration bugs fixed. Real tasks done on emulator-5554: Bluetooth on (5 steps), Chrome search (5), Clock→Alarms (1), Dark theme (3). Voice path: spoken 'Open settings and turn on Bluetooth' → delegation → JEV loop → Bluetooth on → GPT said 'Done—Bluetooth is on now.' Orchestrator re-verified merged main: Dark theme off in 2 steps, $0.00035.

tasks.title: OpenAI (ChatGPT) login flow: onboarding/login screen, in-app browser, callback + token exchange, account display, sign-out, error handling; verified on the emulator
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Sign-in screen (ChatGPT or API key), Custom Tabs, waiting/success/error states, account mode with sign-out/switch, survives rotation and process death, port fallback 1457. 58 JVM tests pass incl. pinned token-exchange body. Real sign-in confirmed by the user on their phone.

tasks.title: JEV API key entered by the user instead of embedded at build time: key screen with live verification, checklist row, clear errors when missing, release builds never embed keys
tasks.summary: Merged to main. JEV key entered in-app (JevKeyActivity) with a live probe (200 = valid, 401/403 = rejected), stored encrypted via Keystore, checklist row, clear 'Add your JEV API key' errors in the pill and spoken by GPT. Release builds never embed keys (verified: no apikey_ string in the release APK). 66 JVM tests pass.

tasks.title: Bubble colours per state (grey idle, amber connecting, green listening, blue GPT speaking, red error) per user feedback
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Bubble colour per state: grey idle, amber connecting, green listening (brighter while you speak), blue while GPT speaks with a speaker icon, red on error; strip tinted green/blue while a task runs; 150 ms cross-fades. Verified on dark and light screens.

tasks.title: Port the upstream dashboard: in-app Runs screen with per-step screenshots, actions, confidence/alternatives, tokens, cost, status, totals, trash
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Runs & costs screen: totals (runs, cost, tokens, success rate), per-run rows with status chips, live card with Stop, step-by-step detail with annotated screenshots, confidence bars and alternatives, timings, tokens, cost; Trash with restore/delete forever; Share report.json. Verified against report.json totals on emulator-5554. 80 JVM tests pass.

tasks.title: Foldables: bubble must be movable over the whole screen after unfolding/folding (display size changes)
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Root cause: overlay cached the screen size and its one post-fold rebuild ran before window metrics updated, leaving the bubble off-screen (fold) or clamped to the old bounds (unfold). Fix: live metrics cross-checked against DisplayManager, re-layout on config/display/window callbacks with settle retries, bubble keeps its edge + vertical fraction. Verified on the foldable AVD in both states and rotations; 10 geometry tests.

tasks.title: APK size: per-ABI release APKs (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86 + universal) and R8 minification with keep rules verified on device
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Release = per-ABI APKs + universal (arm64-v8a 13.0 MB, armeabi-v7a 8.3 MB, x86_64 14.3 MB, x86 13.8 MB, universal 43.3 MB; dex 8 MB → 1.6 MB) with R8 + resource shrinking; versionCode = base*10+abi. Keep rules verified on a minified build: JEV task, Runs screen, GPT-Live call, key probe, login screen. scripts/release.sh builds, verifies signatures, rejects embedded keys, copies APKs + mapping to dist/.

tasks.title: Voice cost in Runs & costs: persist per-session GPT-Live usage (minutes, backend, turns, delegated tasks), show equivalent API pricing ($0.05/min) for both routes, totals and all-in cost
tasks.summary: Merged to main. Per-call voice records (files/voice/*.json) with billed seconds from the server's usage events, $0.05/min equivalent (per-second, session time incl. silence; source: developers.openai.com pricing), turns and delegated tasks linked to runs. Runs & costs: voice totals + All-in, Voice tab, 'Triggered by voice session' in run detail. Also fixed a native crash on audio drop and a call left open on OpenAI's side. 105 JVM tests pass.

tasks.title: Laya-Android model conversion: fetch ByunByun/laya-android, reproduce its candidate serialization + questions in Python, export to a mobile graph (LiteRT preferred, ONNX fallback) at a 1024-token window, parity fixtures + host contract
tasks.summary: LiteRT export of Laya-Android done on macOS (litert-torch 0.9.3, community recipe re-implemented): one 275 MB wfp16 .tflite with signatures s256/s512/s1024/s2048 sharing weights (+ single-window files), 393 MB fp16 token table, tokenizer. Parity vs laya 0.3.28 PyTorch on 24 rows / 50 questions over 10 hand-built UiTrees: token ids identical, argmax identical everywhere, max |dp| 0.00042 (wfp16) / 0.00000 (fp32). Mac M5 CPU: 194 ms/question at 512, 478 at 1024; adaptive window 394 ms/step median. tools/laya/HOST_CONTRACT.md is the Kotlin spec (T=1.1609, head_max_len 1536, act head ignored, tokenizer.json truncation trap). Extra untrained ops/text question: not recommended.
log: candidates.py: faithful port of Byun11 candidates/serialization for our UiTree; 10 realistic trees incl. keyboard, dialog, >40 candidates
export.py: explicit rewrite matches laya forward to 1.7e-5; LiteRT conversion + fp16 FC weights; multi-signature shared-weight file
parity.py: all windows/storages argmax-identical, max |dp| 0.00042; extra_ops_study: extras never flip trained argmax but take 0.3-22% mass
